title: NeuroWare Innovation and Knowledge Centre (IKC)
summary: The NeuroWare IKC is a UK-wide initiative led by UCL in partnership with institutions like the University of Manchester. It aims to accelerate neuromorphic hardware development for low-power AI, edge devices, and sustainable computing through collaboration between researchers, industry, investors, and policymakers.
tldr: NeuroWare IKC advances UK neuromorphic systems via a consortium led by UCL focusing on energy-efficient hardware adoption.
evidence: The NeuroWare Innovation and Knowledge Centre (IKC) is a UK-wide initiative led by UCL in partnership with a consortium of leading UK institutions.
NeuroWare accelerates the development, commercialisation and adoption of neuromorphic hardware.
